description:
Search 13 additional tools that are loaded on demand. Send one keyword query per capability you need; returns matching tool names and descriptions. Then `tool_describe` loads schemas and `tool_call` invokes. Tools already in your tool list need no search. Searches also cover the user's connected app accounts, whose tools are hosted and so never listed here (results named `connectors__<app>__<tool>`); `manage_connections` checks or connects an account.

Every tool listed below exists: never call it unavailable, and go straight to `tool_describe` when you see the exact name.

Deferred tool catalog (call schemas via `tool_describe`, invoke via `tool_call`):
- browser_vault: Fill saved logins, 2FA codes, cards and addresses on the CURRENT browser page.
- computer_use: Drive the desktop via cua-driver: screenshots, mouse, keyboard, scroll, drag.
- cronjob_manage: Schedule recurring or one-off agent tasks (cron jobs): create, list, edit, run.
- image_generate: Generate or edit images (with reference images) using the configured model.
- session_search: Search or read past Hermes conversations (FTS5), or scroll inside one.
- process_manage: Poll, wait on, send input to, or kill terminal(background=true) processes.
- todo_list: Track a task list for multi-step work (3+ steps).
moss tools (6):
- moss_dialogue_tts: Moss multi-speaker dialogue TTS.
- moss_transcribe: Moss speech-to-text: transcribe an audio file into text, with optional…
- moss_vision: Moss MOSS-VL: image/video understanding (OCR, captioning, video Q&A) via the…
- moss_voice_clone: Clone a voice from a reference audio sample (mp3/wav).
- moss_voice_design: Moss voice design: synthesize speech in a style described by an instruction…
- moss_voice_list: List Moss voices: the 15 built-in voices plus any voices you have cloned.
name: tool_search

queries.description: One query per capability: service + action + object keywords (e.g. ['gmail send email', 'github create issue']), never a question; every word must match tool text. Searched in parallel.
